items.title: Role of Logic in Reasoning and Decision Making (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Role of Logic in Reasoning and Decision Making with the Class Activity (PDF 26-27, printed 22-23).

blocks.text: Reasoning (daleel se sochna) aur faisla karne mein logic ka bara kirdar hai. Yeh computers aur insaanon dono ko sahi nateeja (conclusion) nikalne mein madad deti hai. Logic se faisle facts aur qaidon ki bunyad par hote hain. Is se uljhan aur andaze (guesswork) khatam ho jate hain. Logical reasoning masle ko qadam ba qadam hal karti hai. Computer sahi kaam chunne ke liye logic istemal karte hain. Logic faislon ko hamesha ek jaisa (consistent) aur durust (accurate) rakhti hai. Yeh expert systems aur artificial intelligence (AI) mein istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
• Baat karein ke logic faisle karne mein kaise madad deti hai.
• Students school ki zindagi ke baare mein aasan “if-then” (agar-to) jumle banayein.
• Misal: “Agar barish hui, to hum andar rahenge.”

items: Logic se faisle facts aur qaidon par hote hain, andaze par nahi.
Faisle ek jaise (consistent) aur durust (accurate) rehte hain; expert systems aur AI mein istemal.
